builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21, for the girls soccer build: the club records from each club's own website; the ties from PrepSoccer and TopDrawerSoccer player pages, the players' Hudl, SportsRecruits, NCSA and claimed MaxPreps career pages, and the commitment sources. Every tie's sources re-read at assembly by a separate script; no script rebuilds this file. On 2026-11-22 the ECNL and ECNL Regional League team rosters were compared with the rosters and their ties added by hand (notes); on 2026-11-24 those of the Regional League's Golden State conference the same way.
notes: The youth soccer clubs players on the tracked girls varsity soccer rosters (the 82 schools of the SCVAL, BVAL, WCAL, WBAL, PAL and SCCAL; 32 with a MaxPreps roster on 2026-11-21) are tied to, and the other girls' clubs in San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara and Santa Cruz counties. The linking rule is field hockey's (README, "Clubs"): a public page must name the player and a soccer club, and either name the player's high school (with the right city where the name has namesakes), or give a class year equal to the roster's along with a hometown in the school's own area. A name alone never counts, a class year that disagrees with the roster rules a match out, and social media is never a source.

Club records (50): each written from the club's own website (about 270 club pages read). The candidate list was NorCal Premier's club directory (302 clubs, 73 in the four counties), Girls Academy's member lists and the Aspire directory, and Cal North District 2's list. San Francisco, the Peninsula and the South Bay were searched for every club; Santa Cruz County was too, but not Monterey or San Benito County, so the Central Coast is not searched completely; the one East Bay record (Mustang Soccer League) is there because a player is tied to it. Cal North District 1's list and ECNL's member list (drawn by script) were not read; ECNL membership is as each club's own site says. By region: south-bay 19, peninsula 15, san-francisco 10, central-coast 5, east-bay 1.

Ties: from PrepSoccer player pages (reached by an address probe of all 634 varsity rows: 752 addresses, 63 live) whose school link resolves to the right city, TopDrawerSoccer club-player profiles (634 searches, 35 profiles read), the players' Hudl profiles (each on the school's own soccer team; the team list's club entries, latest per club, entries before sixth grade dropped), the club-teams block of claimed MaxPreps career pages, the club block of kept SportsRecruits soccer profiles, the dated 'Club Information' lines of kept NCSA soccer profiles (the undated header club, events, camps and leagues not used), and the commitment sources (a college's signing release, SoccerWire, TopDrawerSoccer and PrepSoccer). One tie per player and club, the sources of every pass merged.

Status. current: a source dated 2026 or the 2026-27 club season (a MaxPreps entry joined or edited in 2026, a Hudl entry reaching 2026, an NCSA club line for 2026, a page dated 2026 that says so). An NCSA club line dated after 2026 is a team's class label and dates nothing (unknown). past: a Hudl entry that ends in 2024 or earlier, or a MaxPreps entry last edited before 2025. unknown: everything else, such as a Hudl entry for 2025, a MaxPreps entry edited in 2025, an undated profile (SportsRecruits' club blocks carry no season) or a PrepSoccer page created before 2026. Team names such as '09G ECNL' are birth-year labels and date nothing.

Second reader at assembly (2026-11-21): a separate script re-fetched every tie's every source and checked the quote on the page as served (Hudl and SportsRecruits through the data the page itself loads; pages the pass read rendered, in headless Chromium). Every source confirmed. MaxPreps' club entries are cited on the career page's Bio tab, where the pass read them, and quoted as the page's own run of fields. A PrepSoccer program page is quoted as its class heading and the player's row. 2 ties found on a player's JV-list row are left out because the same player's varsity row has a grade whose class year the page contradicts.

League rosters, 2026-11-22 (README, "Club rosters"): the public team rosters of ECNL Girls Northern Cal and the ECNL Regional League's NorCal girls division, GU14 through GU18/19 (199 teams of 55 clubs; kept in club-rosters.json), compared with every varsity and JV row by pnpm compare-club-rosters. The league-roster rule (lib/players/club-rosters.ts): the folded names are equal, the row has a grade and the roster's class year is that grade's, no other tracked school has the name, every agreeing roster row is at one club, and the club has a record here and is based in San Francisco, on the Peninsula, in the South Bay or on the Central Coast. A roster names no school, so a tie resting on one alone is medium confidence. 96 ties cite a roster (source kind league-roster, 110 entries on 32 team pages, each quoted as the team's name and the player's row on the page's Roster dialog; the class year is in the data the page loads): 63 new ties rest on a roster alone; 32 ties other pages already made gained it and are now current for 2026-27, Sally Burns's to Mustang Soccer (East Bay) among them; and Delaney Kumer's to Marin FC is new, resting on TopDrawerSoccer's UC Davis list (class year, hometown San Carlos, the club) with the roster, with a record for Marin FC written from its own site. Second reader: a separate script opened all 32 team pages (and 2 more) in Chromium, pressed Roster and found every cited row as displayed. Not linked: 30 varsity and 11 JV rows with no grade whose name is on a roster; 11 varsity rows whose class year disagrees with every roster row of the name and 5 rows (1 JV) whose roster rows carry none; Vivian Baker (Mitty), listed at that class year by two clubs; Taylor Williams (Branham, Marin FC), Tanisha Rameshkumar (Valley Christian, Pleasanton Rage, a club with no record) and a JV player at Evergreen Valley (Mustang Soccer), each at a club outside the area with no other page. No JV row passed the rule.

League rosters, 2026-11-24: the ECNL Regional League's Golden State conference (the 12 ECNL Northern Cal clubs' second teams, Athlete One event 4300; 57 teams added to club-rosters.json) read and compared the same way, under the same rule, now over three leagues. 38 more ties cite a roster, all at Golden State teams: 33 new ties at 11 schools resting on a roster alone (MVLA 23, Bay Area Surf 6, De Anza Force 4), medium confidence; and 5 ties other pages already made, which gain the roster and are now current for 2026-27 (Dylan Harrison, Los Altos, and Sora Cerniglia, Mitty, to MVLA; Melanie Adler, Wilcox, and Isabella Larsen, Sobrato, to Bay Area Surf; Emerinne Denina, Monta Vista, to De Anza Force). 40 entries on 12 team pages. Second reader: a separate script opened the 12 pages in Chromium, pressed Roster and found all 40 cited rows as displayed, with the label the copy gives. In all, 134 ties cite a roster (150 entries on 44 team pages, 23 schools). Not linked: 3 JV rows that pass the rule (Branham 2, Willow Glen 1), as no JV tie is listed.

No record, so no tie shown, although a player's page names the club: El Camino FC (sobrato / Lauren Crowell, maxpreps); alum rock fc (overfelt / Violeta Murillo, maxpreps); Hawaii Rush Soccer (Girls) (valley-christian / Alessia Costa, sportsrecruits); Newark 1974 FC (santa-clara / Dhiaan Plaha, ncsa); Reno Apex (cupertino / Emily Sugimura, ncsa); AllStars FC (sobrato / Isabella Larsen, ncsa); Alum Rock Futbol Club (overfelt / Violeta Murillo, ncsa); Silicon Valley Soccer Club (carlmont / Gianna Armanini, ncsa). "AFC", as one Leland player's SportsRecruits page gives it, is not mapped to Almaden FC: the athlete-entered name has no team or city (her Hudl page ties her to Almaden FC, and that tie is listed). Nor is "Surf" on one Mitty player's NCSA page mapped (Santa Cruz Mid-County also goes by Surf); her Bay Area Surf tie rests on other pages and is listed. TopDrawerSoccer's "FC Bay Area" is read as Bay Area Surf only where a second page names Bay Area Surf.

JV ties (jvAffiliations), since 2026-11-25: a JV row's ties are listed apart from the varsity rows' and join the school's MaxPreps JV roster (data/soccer/jv-rosters.json; lib/players/clubs.ts withJvListRows). A player on both the JV and the varsity list has her ties on the varsity row. They came from the league rosters only (the league-roster rule, as for varsity rows) until two Hudl entries on 2026-11-25 (below); first 4 ties at 3 schools, Samantha Erickson and Taylor Laughter (Branham) and Isabel Ramirez-Ortega (Pioneer) to De Anza Force, Lelie Vatton Raclot (Willow Glen) to Bay Area Surf, medium, current for 2026-27; a separate run pressed Roster on the 3 cited pages and found all 5 cited rows. Of the JV rows, only the 4 tied players were looked for on SportsRecruits and Hudl (2026-11-25, nothing found); PrepSoccer, TopDrawerSoccer, NCSA and MaxPreps career pages were not searched for JV rows and the JV rows with no grade whose name is on a roster linked on 2026-11-25 under the loosened rule (below). Shown since 2026-11-25: the JV roster's club line, the club pages (marked JV) and /recruiting.

League rosters, 2026-11-25: Girls Academy's Northwest conference, 38 GA teams U14-U19 of eight clubs, each team's public roster on GotSport Rankings (README, 'Club rosters'; kept in club-rosters.json as league ga). The page gives no class year, so a GA row is compared on the team's birth years (California's September 1 cutoff: 'GA 08/09' admits the classes of 2026-2028), in a tier of its own (lib/players/club-rosters.ts): an ECNL row at another club neither blocks a GA match nor is blocked by one. 29 varsity rows match: 22 new ties resting on a GA roster alone, medium confidence and status unknown (the page has no date), and 7 ties other pages already made, which gain the roster and keep their status. By club: Almaden FC 16, Silicon Valley SA 13, San Francisco Glens 0. Each source quotes the page's own team name and the player's row; a player on two of a club's GA teams cites both. Second reader: a separate run opened every cited team page in Chromium and found each cited row as displayed. Not linked: Tatum Hadfield (Valley Christian), on 1974 Newark FC's GA 10/11 only (no record; East Bay); 2 JV rows with no grade (Los Gatos, Leland) on Almaden's GA 09/10. South Valley Surf, Lamorinda, Sacramento United and Clovis Crossfire rows matched no tracked row.

League rosters, 2026-11-25 (ECNL): the MaxPreps refresh of 2026-11-24/25 brought rows the three ECNL leagues' kept rosters (read 2026-11-22 and 2026-11-24) match under the same rule: 9 varsity rows, at Pioneer (6) and Notre Dame San Jose (3). 6 new ties resting on a roster alone, medium, current for 2026-27 (Mariana Mejia to MVLA; Addison Amooi to Los Gatos United; Luna Hernandez to Santa Clara Sporting; Sonia Garcia and Mattie Chukwudebe to De Anza Force; Alessandra Barba to Los Gatos United); and 3 ties other pages already made, which gain the roster and now read current for 2026-27 (Isabella Guillebeaux and Addison Subala to De Anza Force, Valerie Contreras to Bay Area Surf). 15 entries on 13 team pages. Second reader: a separate run opened the 13 pages in Chromium, pressed Roster and found all 15 cited rows as displayed, with the position and label the copy gives. The 4 JV rows that pass the rule (Branham 2, Pioneer 1, Willow Glen 1) are listed in jvAffiliations (below).

Mitty, 2026-11-25. MaxPreps' Mitty roster of 2026-11-24 no longer lists Zuri Brandt (#20, grade 12) or Scarlett Martinez (#4, grade 11): 26 players on 2026-11-21, 24 on 2026-11-24, no other change. Hudl's 2026 Mitty varsity roster, read 2026-11-25, still lists both. The owner decided: Zuri Brandt's 3 ties (De Anza Force, MVLA, San Francisco Elite) are removed, as she is a senior and may have left the team (git history keeps them); Scarlett Martinez's tie to De Anza Force is kept, though it is left out as roster drift while MaxPreps does not list her, and shows again if MaxPreps lists her again.

League rosters, 2026-11-25 (NorCal Premier): the girls U14-U19 teams in NorCal Premier's two 2026-27 leagues on GotSport, the NorCal N1 League (event 54043) and the Fall League (54541), of Almaden FC and the NorCal Premier-only clubs Sunnyvale Alliance, FC Milpitas (Milpitas YSL on GotSport), Peninsula Youth Soccer and ALBION SC Silicon Valley (its San Mateo club), each team's public roster on GotSport Rankings (README, 'Club rosters'; kept in club-rosters.json as leagues n1 and norcal-fall). Compared on birth years like Girls Academy's. 8 rows match: 6 new ties resting on a roster alone (5 varsity, 1 JV; Almaden FC 3, Sunnyvale Alliance 2, FC Milpitas 1), medium, status unknown, and 2 ties other pages already made, which gain the roster and keep their status (Mahi Nanda, Evergreen Valley, to Almaden FC; Tuhina Samaddar, Wilcox, to Sunnyvale Alliance). With them, 3 ECNL matches at the PCAL schools added on 2026-11-25 (Fynlee Devine and Kayden Aguilera, Salinas, and Amalia Phillips, Palma, to Bay Area Surf), medium, current for 2026-27. Second reader: a separate run opened all 6 Rankings pages and pressed Roster on the 5 Athlete One pages, and found all 17 cited rows as displayed.

Rows with no grade, and the JV players' Hudl club entries, 2026-11-25 (README, 'Club rosters'). Every soccer Hudl profile linked in rosters-enrichment.json and jv-profiles.json (187) was read again for its team list's club entries: every varsity player's is tied already; two JV players' are new, Noa Goldberg's and Mari Madalen Jan's (Mountain View) to De Anza Force's 'Force (CA) ECNL G2011/12', high confidence, citing the Hudl entry and the ECNL rosters (which give Noa Goldberg no class year). JV profiles had not been read for clubs before. The league-roster rule was loosened the same day (owner decision): a row with no grade takes the class year its own linked recruiting pages state, else the roster's own, when every roster row of the name that gives a class year gives the same one and it is a class in high school in 2026-27; a linked page's class year that disagrees rules a match out. MaxPreps posts no grade for whole schools (Los Gatos), whose players the rule had taken none of. 42 new ties (41 by the rule, medium; class year from the roster 36, from the player's linked page 5) and 5 ties that gain a roster and read current for 2026-27 (Kinsley Ozawa, Claire Chen, Ava Porter, Harper Satterlee, Mari Madalen Jan). Los Gatos gains 20 (13 varsity, 7 JV). Second reader: fetch-club-rosters read all 256 ECNL teams afresh the same day, identical to the kept copy, and every cited ECNL row was found in it as quoted; Charlotte Markovic's (Los Gatos JV) tie to Almaden FC rests on its GA 09/10 and N1 G2008/09 GotSport rosters, both re-read in Chromium, and her SportsRecruits page's class year; status unknown.
